title: Update Fumadocs homepage to use index.md and fix links
body:
- [x] Rename components index from index.mdx to index.md
- [x] Fix all links in components index.md
- [x] Create an index.md for plugins (similar to components)
- [x] Move plugins directory from ecosystem/plugins to top-level docs/plugins
- [x] Update docs/meta.json to include plugins at top level
- [x] Update ecosystem/meta.json to remove plugins reference
- [x] Update all references to plugin files throughout the documentation
- [x] Fix all links in plugins index.md
- [x] Fix lazy-loading references in plugin files and concepts
- [x] Fix /docs/ prefixes in all documentation links
- [x] Verify all changes work correctly

## Verification Summary

✅ Components index: `docs/components/index.md` (renamed from .mdx)
✅ Plugins index: `docs/plugins/index.md` (created)
✅ Plugins directory: Moved to top-level `docs/plugins/`
✅ Navigation: Plugins added to docs/meta.json
✅ All links: Fixed (no /docs/ prefixes, correct relative paths)
✅ Old directory: `docs/ecosystem/plugins/` removed

All changes verified and complete!
